trap.label: pergunta retórica
trap.wrong: Don’t I always? No, I answer not.
trap.why: Em português a pergunta retórica costuma ter resposta explícita; em inglês o auxiliar negativo já responde sem responder.

opts: Wouldn’t you say it is still the best?
Would you say it is the worst?

fix.wrong: It is still the best, doesn’t it?
fix.right: It is still the best, isn’t it?

fix.wrong: Wouldn’t you to say it is true?
fix.right: Wouldn’t you say it is true?

rewrite.prompt: Tag question: “It is still the best.”
rewrite.answer: It is still the best, isn’t it?

rewrite.prompt: Pergunta retórica negativa: “You would say it is true.”
rewrite.answer: Wouldn’t you say it is true?
